title: The Perfect Product That Lost a Customer
hook: Your product was perfect. You still lost the customer.
script: Your product was perfect. You still lost the customer. Imagine a buyer pays on Monday. You promise delivery on Friday, but the date gets buried in a WhatsApp chat. Friday comes. The order isn't ready. The customer doesn't just remember the product; they remember the broken promise. Here's the fix: record every order, payment status, delivery deadline, and the person responsible. Before closing each day, check what must go out tomorrow. Reliability is marketing you don't have to pay for.
visual_plan: 0-2s: Stark cyan headline 'PERFECT PRODUCT. LOST CUSTOMER.' beside disappointed shop customer
2-5s: Monday order placed; customer pays; clear calendar overlay
5-8s: Seller promises Friday delivery; order detail sinks into WhatsApp messages
8-11s: Friday calendar flips; packed goods still missing
11-14s: Customer waits beside unread delivery message
14-17s: Shop owner realizes missed deadline; dramatic cyan calendar alert
17-20s: Contrast product quality with broken promise
20-23s: Order tracking board appears with customer, payment, due date, owner
23-26s: Four key fields highlighted one at a time
29-33s: Goods delivered on time; relieved customer
editorial_notes: Hypothetical scenario, not a real customer testimonial. The current renderer does not consume visual_plan; storyboard is for future implementation. Default voice rotation remains enabled; voice effect not established.
